title: ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents' Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces
topic: 真实任务与可靠性评测
first_author_affiliation: Fudan University / Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
code_status: 项目站arebench.com只提供联系评测入口，本轮未找到公开任务/源码下载，未接入官方数据集。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.agent_research.are_bench import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.available_resource: 单张 A100/A30 或本地 Mac

summary: ARE-bench要求Agent在真实历史请求和未清理workspace中继续科研交付，用全条目通过率及逐任务checklist均值评估。本地仅实现隔离和计分合同，未宣称官方数据集已接入。
